title: Limit on Leases Held per Customer — ComfortLease Equipment Leases
content:
**Rule.** A customer may hold up to 2 ComfortLease Equipment Leases agreements at the service address, counting leases in pending installation, active or past due status — typically one for heating and one for cooling, or one per zone.

The limit is the same on every system:

| Leased system | Leases one customer may hold |
|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | 2 |
| ComfortLease Central Air | 2 |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | 2 |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | 2 |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | 2 |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | 2 |

## Which leases count

| Status of an existing lease | Counts toward the limit of 2 |
|---|---|
| Pending installation | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Past due | Yes |
| Bought out | No |
| Terminated | No |

## Worked cases (hypothetical customers)

- A customer with one active lease and one lease pending installation holds 2 counted leases; a third lease would exceed the limit.
- A customer with one active lease and one lease bought out last year holds 1 counted lease; the bought-out lease does not count.
- A customer whose only other lease was terminated holds 0 counted leases.
